text: In seventeen fifteen, The Night Watch was moved to a room in Amsterdam's town hall. Around that time, it was cut down at the edges to fit its new place. Most of the loss was on the left, where two men and a child disappeared.
spoken_text: In seventeen fifteen, The Night Watch was moved to a room in Amsterdam's town hall. Around that time, it was cut down at the edges to fit its new place. Most of the loss was on the left, where two men and a child disappeared.
phonemes: ɪn sˈɛvəntˌiːn fˈɪftiːn, ðə nˈaɪt wˈɑːtʃ wʌz mˈuːvd tʊ ɐ ɹˈuːm ɪn ˈæmstɚdˌæmz tˈaʊn hˈɔːl. ɚɹˈaʊnd ðæt tˈaɪm, ɪt wʌz kˈʌt dˌaʊn æt ðɪ ˈɛdʒᵻz tə fˈɪt ɪts nˈuː plˈeɪs. mˈoʊst əv ðə lˈɔs wʌz ɔnðə lˈɛft, wˌɛɹ tˈuː mˈɛn ænd ɐ tʃˈaɪld dˌɪsɐpˈɪɹd.
